invariants.rule: Repair must not begin before the runtime acceptance failure is appended and bound to the original acceptance ID.
invariants.positive_case: The failure row is preserved before diagnosis or source edits.
invariants.negative_case: The code is patched first and the runtime failure is summarized later.

invariants.rule: An implementation defect must not restart Requirements, Overview, or Detail.
invariants.positive_case: The structured detail.userRole field-loss repair resumes Phase 2 only.
invariants.negative_case: The same accepted user outcome is sent through the complete Full planning chain.

invariants.rule: Repair and Review must not perform affinity, classification, or production repair after failure append until CH-01 recomputes an exact current dual-snapshot AcceptanceResolution with both blocker sets empty and selects that failure; they must not read/select ledger or register entries.
invariants.positive_case: The failure is appended first, the old resolution becomes stale, CH-01 returns a canonical open-debt-free resolution selecting the failure, and Repair plus Review consume that same object before maximum rollback classification.
invariants.negative_case: Repair reuses the pre-append resolution, an acceptance-ID-filtered failure, or a private projection with lost provenance/debt and resumes Phase 2 before CH-01 re-resolution.

invariants.rule: A real upstream planning defect must not be hidden by an implementation-only patch.
invariants.positive_case: An incorrect Detail field contract returns to Detail and affected downstream evidence.
invariants.negative_case: Code is changed to contradict the still-confirmed Detail.

invariants.rule: ClosureSpec TaskRef-locates journal and acknowledges prepared before Repair append. Append ref alone stays open. Repair builds record/ref; acknowledged record-bound includes both refs and exact closes_attempt_ids (ordinal-0 or 0+1), binding the whole chain. Missing/extra/cross-chain IDs or missing/corrupt blocks; one retry maximum.
invariants.positive_case: Prepared ack precedes append; accepted or unique suffix match yields append ref, Repair builds record/ref, and acknowledged record-bound with both refs closes before Workflow resolves.
invariants.negative_case: After accepted pending row, journal rolls to older valid prefix/empty or supplies cross-position/repeated-row ref; later pass must not bypass or loop retry.
test_evidence: pre-existing identical row and committed-unacknowledged Finish-bypass scenarios
fresh-session exact-path discovery and missing/corrupt journal scenario
append-ack before record-bound crash with later-pass scenario
older-valid/empty rollback plus cross-position/repeated-row correlation fixture

invariants.rule: The workflow must not claim in-place reopen or machine baseline inheritance for an archived task.
invariants.positive_case: A linked repair task references historical artifacts and states current Gate limits.
invariants.negative_case: The archived task is represented as active without script capability.

invariants.rule: The repair path must not require a Trellis, Guru, Python, shell, or CLI TypeScript script change.
invariants.positive_case: Only approved Markdown and TOML source contracts change.
invariants.negative_case: The proposed fix edits guru_gate.py, task.py, hooks, apply, or packages/cli/src TypeScript.
